finding: At the start of the verse-3 reports, Tabari's section heading attributes one reported identification to al-As ibn Wa'il al-Sahmi. The following eight displayed report units have distinct wording and named transmitters/quoted authorities. The first quoted Ibn Abbas wording is only 'your enemy'; the section heading supplies the al-As identification. Preserve that distinction rather than rewriting every report as though it explicitly names al-As.
